versions.label: V1
versions.title: Complete Creative Worldbuilding Platform
versions.pitch: V1 brings the core Mimir worldbuilding system together with migration, Proving Grounds, collaboration, and hosted participation before public launch.

features.name: Structured entry types and editors
features.desc: Characters, species, cultures, places, factions, artifacts, events, languages, story arcs, quests, dialogue, and more, stored in a connected local lorebible.

features.name: Wiki-links, backlinks, and relationships
features.desc: Connect entries directly and follow those links throughout the world.

features.name: Family, genus, place, culture, and faction trees
features.desc: Dedicated visual structures for understanding how people, species, cultures, factions, and places relate.

features.name: Narrative Planner, story arcs, quests, and dialogue
features.desc: Plan narrative structure and build branching quests and conversations alongside the lore they depend on.

features.name: Calendars and timeline
features.desc: Define in-world calendars and place events across your world's chronology.

features.name: Interactive maps
features.desc: Connect locations and world entries to visual maps rather than keeping geography trapped in prose.

features.name: Spoiler controls
features.desc: Control what is visible when sharing or viewing a world at different spoiler levels.

features.name: Git and history tools
features.desc: Keep a recoverable history of world changes and roll back when needed.

features.name: Mimir AI
features.desc: Ask questions about your own lore. Retrieval supplies relevant world context and Mimir distinguishes canon from inference rather than filling gaps with invented facts.

features.name: Constructed-language Translator
features.desc: Define grammar, vocabulary, registers, and writing systems, then translate consistently against the language you authored.

features.name: Lore Consistency Review
features.desc: Review prose and connected entries for contradictions that deterministic validation cannot understand.

features.name: Validation and naming consistency
features.desc: Catch structural problems, broken relationships, and inconsistent naming before they spread across the project.

features.name: AI Context Bundles
features.desc: Control and reuse the lore context Mimir should consider for deeper questions and creative workflows.

features.name: General file imports
features.desc: Bring existing structured files and prose into Mimir instead of rebuilding material manually.

features.name: Competitor migration
features.desc: Move established worldbuilding projects into Mimir while preserving as much existing structure and content as practical.

features.name: Proving Grounds
features.desc: Prototype conversations, quests, tabletop sessions, board-game systems, and other interactive ideas against the same world data used everywhere else in Mimir.

features.name: Simulation and world-state tools
features.desc: Use variables, conditions, and simulation to test how narrative and interactive structures behave before committing them to canon or production.

features.name: Collaborative workspaces
features.desc: Shared creative work for writers' rooms and teams, with permissions controlling who can edit what.

features.name: Hosted worlds for players and participants
features.desc: Let one power user host a controlled version of the world for players, viewers, or participants without requiring everyone to use Mimir like a creator.

features.name: Live collaborative Proving Grounds
features.desc: Run interactive prototypes with invited participants against the host's world and permissions.

versions.label: Post-V1
versions.title: Feedback, Refinement, and Reliability
versions.pitch: After V1, development deliberately shifts from adding major new categories to learning from real users and making the existing product sharper.

features.name: Onboarding and migration refinement
features.desc: Use real conversion and migration data to remove friction from first launch, imports, and switching from other tools.

features.name: Proving Grounds refinement
features.desc: Expand the workflows that writers, GMs, and designers actually use once Proving Grounds is in their hands.

features.name: Collaboration and hosting hardening
features.desc: Refine permissions, sync, conflict handling, reliability, and participant experience from real shared projects.

features.name: Mimir AI routing and retrieval tuning
features.desc: Improve answer quality, context retrieval, latency, and credit efficiency from measured real-world workloads.

features.name: Accessibility and usability passes
features.desc: Continue improving keyboard, screen-reader, visual, and workflow accessibility from user feedback.

versions.label: Next Major Features
versions.title: AI and Game-Engine Integrations
versions.pitch: Once V1 is stable and real usage has shaped the platform, Mimir expands outward so the same canonical world can serve the rest of a creator's toolchain.

features.name: ChatGPT MCP integration
features.desc: Allow ChatGPT to work against the creator's Mimir world through controlled read and, where appropriate, write operations.

features.name: Claude MCP integration
features.desc: Allow Claude to query and work with the same canonical Mimir world rather than maintaining separate context manually.

features.name: Unreal Engine integration
features.desc: Connect structured Mimir world and narrative data directly to Unreal workflows.

features.name: Unity integration
features.desc: Connect Mimir's canonical world data to Unity projects and narrative systems.

features.name: Godot integration
features.desc: Connect Mimir world data to Godot projects with an integration designed around the engine's workflow.

features.name: Advanced engine round-tripping
features.desc: Longer-term workflows for keeping game implementation and canonical world data synchronised in both directions.

versions.label: Future
versions.title: Professional and Community Expansion
versions.pitch: These are directions rather than V1 promises. They will be prioritised only when real customers demonstrate the need.

features.name: Mimir Studio/business plan
features.desc: A future business tier for organisations that genuinely need central billing, larger teams, administration, and professional deployment features.

features.name: Advanced team administration
features.desc: Organisation-level permissions, auditability, and account management where professional teams require them.

features.name: Professional onboarding and support options
features.desc: Optional paid onboarding and support packages for larger customers rather than bundling enterprise service into ordinary creator subscriptions.

features.name: Session capture and extraction
features.desc: Potential future workflows for turning recorded design or play sessions into reviewable world and narrative updates.

features.name: Community templates and marketplace expansion
features.desc: Broader discovery and sharing around reusable schemas, packs, and worldbuilding resources if the community wants it.
